Date: 2026-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Inquiry: Redwood listing — CloudSpring evaluation

Hi team,

My name is Samir, I'm on the platform team at CloudSpring. We found your Redwood listing on the Cloud Marketplace and are evaluating inference providers for a proof-of-concept focused on catalog search ranking and recommendation generation.

High level:
- Looking to spin up a short trial (2–4 weeks) to validate latency and embedding quality against our test corpus.
- Primary constraint: strict VPC/networking requirements and audit logs.
- We'd like an intro call to understand onboarding, trial criteria, and pricing for our scale (~5M tokens/month during POC).

Can someone from the Redwood team share availability this week or early next? We prefer US/PST mornings.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Platform Engineer | CloudSpring
samir@cloudspring.io

Hi Samir — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for reaching out via the marketplace. I'm Rafael on the Solutions team at Redwood. Happy to run through onboarding and get a short POC stood up.

Quick answers to the bullets you mentioned:
- Trial: we run a lightweight, self-serve trial that we can augment with a reserved POC environment for teams with VPC needs. Typical POC is 2–4 weeks — we can tailor success criteria.
- Networking & audit logs: our Private deployment supports VPC + KMS and produces audit logs; I can loop in our security contact if you want specific artifacts (SOC 2 checklist, network diagrams).
- Pricing: I can share ballpark numbers ahead of the call — or we can go straight to a short demo and trial kickoff.

If mornings PST work best, here are a few 30-min slots I have this week:
- Wed 7/22 9:30–10:00 AM PT
- Thu 7/23 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Fri 7/24 8:30–9:00 AM PT

You can also pick a time on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/rafael/book?slot=30min

I've attached a short one-pager that outlines how we handle Private deployments and what a typical POC looks like.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — Irene here from our SDR team, looping in to help schedule and to collect a few quick items so we can make the call productive.

Short checklist if you don't mind replying inline:
1) Who will join from CloudSpring? (roles / emails)
2) Primary POC objective (latency SLA, embedding quality, cost target)
3) Any network constraints we should prep for (VPC peering, IP allowlists)

We can plan a 30-min orientation + 30-min technical follow-up with our SE if needed. Rafael shared a few times — I can lock one in.

If Wed morning works for you, I can put a calendar hold for 9:30 AM PT and add a short mutual action plan (attached) so we have success criteria ahead of time.

Thanks — quick reminder: the attached MAP is editable; if you prefer we can convert it to a Google Sheet.

--
Irene Choi
SDR | Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — Connor here (Solutions Engineering). Rafael and Irene looped me in so I can prep any technical artifacts. A couple things I can bring to the call:
- Short demo of a catalog search POC we've done (10–12 min)
- Recommended trial config (GPU type, model family, sequence-length budgets)
- Trial onboarding checklist and trial runbook (I attached a short guide).

Proposed time: Wed 7/22 9:30 AM PT — I've tentatively added a 60-min invite to cover orientation + quick tech deep. If you prefer a shorter intro, we can keep it to 30 and do a separate tech follow-up.

If you can confirm attendees and whether CloudSpring needs a VPC-only trial, we'll prepare the correct environment. Also: does your team have a preferred file for the test corpus? If so, send a sample (S3 link or attachments under 50MB).

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: demo-trial-guidelines.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
